title: Completeness of constructible norms
summary: In the present work we study for a given Banach space the quotient of the family of equivalent norms modulus the collinearity relationship and prove that under a Banach-Mazur type metric this family is a complete metric space, and we also prove the completeness of the family of constructible norms for the Banach space of bounded Lipschitzian mappings between convex sets of a Banach space.
